description: Connect to the live paid x402 creator-experience service for travelers, creators, influencers, and agents planning a shareable day trip, weekend, layover, or destination story. Use when the traveler cares about visuals, story, timing, food stops, scenic movement, weather-aware backups, or content moments. The MCP can return live server output or x402 request metadata for clients that can pay with x402.

audience.description: Who the content should speak to, such as couples, solo travelers, families, students, food lovers, or weekend explorers.

avoid.description: Optional list of things to avoid.

budget.description: Budget preference, such as free, low-cost, mid-range, luxury, or a specific amount.

content_style.description: Desired style, such as cinematic, cozy, budget, food-focused, outdoorsy, romantic, luxury, hidden-gem, or short-form video.

destination.description: Destination, city, region, route, or place the influencer experience should be built around.

mobility.description: Mobility or pace preference, such as easy walking, stroller-friendly, low stairs, car-free, or relaxed.

must_include.description: Optional list of moments or constraints to include.

season.description: Season, month, weather context, or event timing.

trip_length.description: Trip length, such as day trip, 24 hours, weekend, layover, or 3 days. Default: day trip.

name: creator_experiences
